members.name: OnGUI
members.signature: public override void OnGUI(Paper paper, float width, float height)

docs.summary: Write panel-specific state for layout persistence. Return false if nothing to save.
Restore panel state from a previously serialized blob.
Width (px) to reserve on the right side of this panel's tab bar for header controls (e.g. a refresh or options button). 0 = no header controls. Only the active tab's panel draws its header content.

members.name: OnHeaderContent
members.signature: public override void OnHeaderContent(Paper paper, float width, float height)

docs.summary: Draw controls into the reserved header area on the right of the leaf's tab bar. The area is `width` (= [`HeaderWidth`](#api~Prowl.Editor.GUI.Panels.GameViewPanel~HeaderWidth)) by `height` (tab-bar height). Called for the active tab only, inside a right-aligned Row.

Called once when the user closes this panel's tab, permanently removing it from the dock tree. NOT called when the tab is merely dragged to a different dock/floating window - the panel stays open in that case. Override to release resources (GPU handles, event subscriptions, etc.) the panel would otherwise hold onto for the rest of the process.
